description.value: Salt Spring Inn is a hotel and restaurant located in Ganges, the main village on Salt Spring Island, BC—a popular destination on the Southern Gulf Islands cycling circuit. The inn combines guestrooms with a full-service restaurant offering breakfast, lunch, and dinner, making it a convenient base for cyclists arriving by BC Ferries. Its central Ganges location puts it within reach of island trails, shops, and the Saturday farmers market.
